scope: Nominal 50% GPU-event duty; gross GPU board energy includes per-window idle inside each block, excludes bank setup and validation outside blocks. Not sustained unpaced or PSU/CPU energy.
sensor: 10-Hz continuous NVML instantaneous power trapezoids; continuously sampled energy counter is a cross-check. Driver-reported sensor accuracy is not established by a statistical CI.
